description: Union trades HVAC sequence: PPE and recovery plan, diagnose from pressures/temperatures/airflow together, braze with nitrogen purge and leak-check, evacuate/charge/commission, record and debrief. Grounded in EPA Section 608: never intentionally vent refrigerant; certification is an external EPA 608 exam. Simulation only — not certification, not licensure.

sources: EPA Section 608 (epa.gov/section608; 40 CFR Part 82, Subpart F, Clean Air Act): prohibits intentionally venting ozone-depleting refrigerants and substitutes (e.g. HFCs) during maintenance, service, repair, or disposal; technician certification programmes exist.
TradePath centre JSON — HVAC zone session + next-3 skills (Refrigeration Cycle & Diagnostics, Brazing & Copper Line Sets, EPA 608 Prep).

stations.title: Safety station — PPE, first aid, extinguisher
Condenser unit — outdoor unit + copper lines
Brazing bench — torch, manifold gauges, nitrogen

steps.action: PPE check + recovery plan. Never vent refrigerant (Section 608).
Diagnose: read pressures, temperatures, and airflow together.
steps.check: Diagnosis named from all three readings.

steps.action: Braze the copper line set with a nitrogen purge, then leak-check.
steps.check: Joint brazed, purge done, no leaks.

steps.action: Evacuate, charge, and commission the unit.
Record the readings and debrief. EPA 608 certification is an external exam — this run does not certify.
